requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Built a small phased-array receive demonstrator using four discone antennas, an RTL-SDR array, and a custom GNURadio flowgraph for real-time beamforming at 435 MHz.

requirements.note: Described in both CV and cover letter as a personal/hobby project rather than professional work; recorded as evidence_found since the text still gives a concrete, specific implementation and the requirement's wording does not restrict to a professional setting.

lines.quote: Write production-grade embedded C++ code for the radar processor boards (Analog Devices SHARC DSPs), including real-time FFT processing, CFAR detection, and plot extraction.
Developed and maintain the Python-based radar simulation and test framework used for regression testing across the full product line.
Performed RF pattern measurements on the company's X-band slotted-waveguide antenna using a Rohde & Schwarz ZVA67 network analyser and a compact antenna test range at the Turku facility.
S. Salminen et al., "Adaptive clutter map for X-band marine radar," SESE Radar Conference 2018 (conference paper)
Nationality: Finnish citizen, EU work authorisation
